Main file: Table 1 (printed p.9; printed page numbers equal PDF pages) rows for commercial/industrial-scale heat pumps (300 kW air-to-air, air-to-water), building-scale boilers (120 kW, typical 40 dwellings), large-scale CHP (500 kWe and 5 MWe gas engines, 5 and 60 MWe biomass steam turbines, 60 and 500 MWe CCGT) and CCS-enabled gas CHP (50 and 500 MW). TRAP: the 'Heating Efficiency' column holds heat-to-power ratios (asterisked) for CHP rows, not efficiencies; thermal and total CHP efficiency are DERIVED (ratio x electric efficiency) with formula. Efficiency columns are headed HHV; boiler efficiencies are indicative seasonal (AFUE) values. Heat-pump capacity basis kWth is assumed (table says kW). CHP costs are per kWe. CCS CHP rows INCLUDE CAPTURE (not split); the EUR570/kW adder, 10% energy penalty and EUR6/MWh opex adder are in _other-values. Not in main file (residential/appliance scale, out of scope): dwelling-scale boilers and furnaces, domestic heat pumps (kept in _other-values; the only gas-absorption heat pump numbers), micro- and mini-CHP, hybrids, air conditioners, radiators.
